content: Always schedule a specific follow-up time when a customer needs to consult others; don't leave it open-ended.
After addressing an objection, actively check for remaining concerns using a question like 'Does that fully address your worry?' to ensure complete resolution.
In-store demos should be interactive and tied to the customer's specific use case (e.g., law students tagging PDFs).
When a customer mentions needing approval, offer to provide a printed summary or a demo for the decision-maker to build trust.

name: Hands-On Feature Demo
condition: When a customer shows interest in a specific feature (e.g., tagging, search).
example: Invite the customer to perform the action themselves on the demo unit, as done in round 3.

name: Empathy + Evidence + Cloud Solution
condition: When a customer raises a storage or performance concern.
example: Acknowledge the concern, provide specific numbers (256GB/512GB), and offer a cloud backup option.

name: Follow-Up Scheduling with Incentive
condition: When a customer needs to consult others before purchasing.
example: Propose a specific time for a joint visit with a limited-time discount to create urgency.

objection: I need to check with my parents first.
rebuttal_template: I completely understand, Kak. How about this: I'll prepare a quick demo video showing how the tagging and search work, and I can also offer a special in-store discount if you and your parents visit together this weekend. Would Saturday or Sunday work better for you?

objection: Will the tablet slow down with many tagged notes?
rebuttal_template: Great question! Let me show you right here on the demo unit—I've loaded 500 PDFs with thousands of tags. Watch how fast the search is. (Demonstrates) As you can see, no lag at all. And with 256GB, you have plenty of space. Would you like to try it yourself?

That's a common concern. Let me check the exact storage on this model—(checks device settings) it shows 256GB total, with 230GB free after system. For your case files, even 10,000 PDFs would only use about 50GB. Plus, you can enable automatic cloud backup for older files. Does that ease your mind?
